raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: poselib
  version: "2.0.5"

package:
  name: ${{ name }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/PoseLib/PoseLib/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: a9493e6725c58e6ae541fe416c0a6179185a60006880ff3ddf32737a43695668
    patches:
      - unvendor_pybind11.patch
      - fix_windows.patch
      - fix_unused_variable.patch
      - fix_gcc_array_bounds.patch
      - fix_cmake_args.patch
      - backport_pr208_onesided_focal.patch

build:
  number: 0

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - cmake
    - if: unix
      then: make
    - ninja
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - pybind11
        - pybind11-stubgen
        - numpy
  host:
    - pip
    - setuptools
    - python
    - pybind11
    - pybind11-stubgen
    - eigen
    - numpy
  run:
    - python
    - numpy
  run_exports:
    - ${{ pin_subpackage('poselib', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - poselib
      pip_check: true
  - requirements:
      run:
        - pip
    script:
      - if: win
        then:
          - if not exist %PREFIX%\\Library\\lib\\PoseLib.lib exit 1
          -  if not exist %PREFIX%\\Library\\lib\\cmake\\PoseLib\\PoseLibConfig.cmake exit 1
          -  if not exist %PREFIX%\\Library\\include\\PoseLib\\poselib.h exit 1
      - if: unix
        then:
          - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libPoseLib${SHLIB_EXT}
          - test -f ${PREFIX}/include/PoseLib/poselib.h
          - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/cmake/PoseLib/PoseLibConfig.cmake

about:
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
  summary: PoseLib provides a collection of minimal solvers for camera pose estimation.
  homepage: https://github.com/PoseLib/PoseLib

extra:
  feedstock-name: poselib
  recipe-maintainers:
    - Tobias-Fischer
